name: ThO2 fluorite, pure endmember1951 experimental lattice
citation: F. Hund and W. Dürrwächter. Anomale Mischkristalle im System ThO2–La2O3. Zeitschrift für anorganische und allgemeine Chemie265 (1951),67–72. DOI10.1002/zaac.19512650108.
recommendation: experimental source candidate; native FEFF and numerical validation pending
method: Experimental lattice determination by the asymmetric Straumanis method; publisher-deposited primary abstract states pureThO2 fluorite endpoint a=5.592±0.0001A. Full ordered fluorite site model is encoded in original COD record; no independent free oxygen position exists for idealFm-3m fluorite.

synthesis_conditions.description: Publisher-deposited abstract reports precipitated thorium/lanthanum nitrate mixtures calcined to oxides at1300C. The selected CIF is pureThO2 endmember, not a mixedLa/Th member. This is synthesis temperature, not measurement temperature.

notes: One independent Th site,multiplicity4,complete cubic eight-O fluorite shell. NoLa or oxygen-vacancy alloy model is imported.
This1951 experimental lattice reference has source precision and unknown measurementconditions; not a modern detailed charge-density refinement.

The native FEFF recipe keeps default frozen-f atomic occupations; actinide5f treatment and charge transfer require separate validation. Atomic frozen-f occupancy is not proof of chemicalTh(IV) occupancy or an accurateL3 spectrum. NoUNFREEZEF or substitution is introduced.
No experimental EXAFS validation or calculated SCF/cluster-radius convergence has been established for this reference.
measurement_conditions_evidence: No measurement temperature or pressure is recorded in the original CIF or publisher-deposited abstract.1300C is calcination and must not be stored as diffraction temperature. Publisher abstract explicitly usesAngstrom for pure-endmember lattice5.592A.
